messages:
Asha Patel: Quick weekend ask — we need a push for the Serving Summit — Production Patterns. Request: X thread (3 tweets), LinkedIn carousel (2 variants), 30s teaser clip, and a lead-routing plan to SDR. Can we lock schedule + owners by EOD today?

Tom Nguyen: Yep. Suggest X: Sat 10:00am PT / LinkedIn carousel: Mon 9:00am PT. Avoid big news windows. Also add closed captions for LI autoplay.

Jordan Lee: I can export teaser v2 (30s) and 3 hero stills. Need final copy + CTAs. Thumbnail sizes?

Asha Patel: X thumb 1200x675, LI carousel thumbs 1080x1080. Evan — can you take copy?

Evan Riley: I’ll draft 3 X thread variants + 2 LI carousel captions. Quick hooks to choose from: 1) “How we shave 40% off per-token cost with prefix caching” 2) “Deploy LLMs with SLA-grade latency” 3) “Making model rollouts boring & safe.” Which tone?

Priya Kapoor: I’ll own lead routing. Preference: HubSpot form -> 'Marketing Inbound' queue. If someone registers + attends -> route to SDR / AE. Want to use HS workflows + SFDC for handoff.

Tom Nguyen: UTM plan: utm_source=social_x | utm_medium=social | utm_campaign=serving_summit_0426. Example query string:

?utm_source=x_social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_summit_0426

Jordan Lee: Uploaded teaser & thumbnails to Drive (link in thread). Adding captions in comments. Will export LI-ready MP4 with burned-in captions by EOD.

sched-bot: Post scheduled: X thread (3 tweets) — Sat 2028-04-26 10:00 PT by @Tom Nguyen. LinkedIn carousel A — Mon 2028-04-28 09:00 PT by @Jordan Lee.

Evan Riley: Sharing Thread drafts (short):
Thread A: "Running LLMs in production shouldn't feel like roulette. Three patterns that keep latency, cost, and quality in check. 1/5
2/5 batching + caching examples
3/5 smart routing + fallbacks
4/5 observability + rollouts
5/5 join Serving Summit: [link]"

Thread B (edgier): "Stop overpaying for tokens. Learn the engineering moves that cut unit cost w/o losing quality. Serving Summit — sign up. [link]"

Asha Patel: Love Thread A. Evan — include AB copy for tweet 2 (cost vs latency CTA).

Evan Riley: Added both variants to the doc; default is 'cost' CTA, but we can flip for the A/B.

Priya Kapoor: Routing checklist I’ll implement: 1) Form submissions -> HS list 'SS-Inbound' 2) Registrants who attend -> SFDC lead status 'Engaged' + create SDR task 3) Qs -> support@redwood.ai with tag 'serving_summit'. I’ll share the HS workflow export for review.

Jordan Lee: CC and burn-in uploaded. Also added a GIF version for X.

Tom Nguyen: Tiny nit: add speaker name + 1-line bio to LI carousel first card. Jordan — can you slot it?

Jordan Lee: Yup. Dropped speaker card in carousel variant B.

Asha Patel: Final owners = Assets: Jordan. Copy + X threads: Evan. Scheduling: Tom. Lead routing + workflows: Priya. Please react :thumbsup: if good.

Tom Nguyen: :thumbsup:

Evan Riley: :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: :thumbsup:

Asha Patel: Thanks all — I’ll post the campaign invite to #marketing-campaigns and paste final copy here before Tom kicks off scheduling."
